articles.summary: MIDLAND, Texas, Sept. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Viper Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: VNOM) (“Viper”), a subsidiary of Diamondback Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: FANG) (“Diamondback”), today announced that it plans to release third quarter 2026 financial results on November 2, 2026 after the market closes.
articles.title: Viper Energy, Inc., a Subsidiary of Diamondback Energy, Inc., Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Conference Call for November 3, 2026
